💡 The novelty lies in a single-molecule polarity-switching phthalimide that toggles between electrophilic (δ+) and nucleophilic (δ−) states, simultaneously suppressing polyiodide shuttling and stabilizing reactive I+ species. This enables four-electron Li-I2 pouch cells with ~400 mAh gI−1, >1200 Wh kgI−1, and 1000-cycle stability, advancing flexible, wearable energy storage.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in an earth-abundant CuCoCeOx catalyst enabling reversible, pretreatment-free LOHC hydrogenation–dehydrogenation via in situ reconstruction into stable Cu(δ+)–CoOx interfacial sites. Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that layered stacking structure governs interlayer transition-metal migration, where the P3 "ABBCCA" ribbon superlattice suppresses O-type stacking faults and enables reversible high-voltage oxygen redox, unlike P2 "ABBA". This is significant because it explains how stacking structure controls oxygen plateau reversibility, offering a design principle for high-capacity, low-hysteresis layered cathodes.
